designationHistory.name: Pleasant Lake Migratory Waterfowl Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt established it as the Pleasant Lake Migratory Waterfowl Refuge by Executive Order 8164 on June 12, 1939, and it was renamed Pleasant Lake National Wildlife Refuge in 1940.
designationHistory.note: Pass A (FWS limited-interest refuges CCP, Table 4) and Pass B (American Presidency Project text and National Archives Executive Orders Disposition Table, 4 FR 2409) agree on order number and date. The refuge is a limited-interest (easement) refuge on private land. Renamed by Proclamation 2416 of July 25, 1940.

sources.name: National Archives, Executive Orders Disposition Tables, 1939
